new_defect.cause: Prefill context injection and decode commit shared mutable projection/K/V scratch while queued consumers ran on different streams.
new_defect.fix: Cache scratch tuples by actual execution stream and retain the selected tuple locally during materialization; weights/RoPE remain shared reads.
new_defect.memory_tradeoff: Scratch capacity can grow separately for every stream that uses the helper.

fixed_reproducer.comparison: Exact K/V equality to serial references across both lanes and three repetitions.

limitations: Adds copies/check kernels and retains references, which can mask timing/lifetime races.
No added cross-lane wait or explicit host synchronization.
Covers selected indices, not every intermediate or legal in-bounds overwrite.
A reported change must be assessed against intentional backend writes.
